text:
ryan_se: Heads-up 10AM call with Meridian sec team. They want a one-page snapshot showing how we handle audit logs, forwarding to customer SIEM, retention numbers and evidence for immutability.

leah_sec: I can draft. Quick checklist: sample admin event, detection example, forwarding snippets (Splunk HEC/syslog/S3), retention defaults, and note about KMS + Object Lock.

ryan_se: Can you keep examples super short, single-line JSON so procurement can copy-paste?

leah_sec: Sure. Admin event: {"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2025-12-05T11:02:00Z","actor":"u_77","action":"enable_audit","target":"deployment_x","req":"req_2001"} 

leah_sec: Detection event: {"event_type":"detection","ts":"2025-12-05T11:05:12Z","name":"multiple_failed_logins","sev":"high","count":27} 

mina_ops: Minimal forwarder (curl to Splunk HEC): curl -s https://splunk.example.com:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log 

leah_sec: Retention defaults to paste: API logs 90d hot / 13mo cold; Admin/audit 1y default; Auth events 13mo; Inference metrics 90d. Option to archive up to 7y to customer S3 with Object Lock in GOVERNANCE mode.

mina_ops: We support customer-managed KMS for S3 exports. In transit TLS1.2+, at-rest AES-256. Access to audit logs is RBACed; read/restore requires SOC or org_admin and all access is itself logged.

ryan_se: Meridian also asked if we can stream detection alerts into their SIEM in near real-time.

leah_sec: Yes 1 we emit structured detection events to the same audit stream and offer webhook subscriptions or direct HEC/syslog forwarding. Mention prebuilt Splunk dashboards in the one-pager.

audit-bot: Audit export job completed for meridian-poc at 2025-12-05T11:40:00Z.

mina_ops: I'll drop the one-pager + two single-line examples into /shared/sales/meridian/ and send to the buyer after your review.

ryan_se: Thanks team 1 sending in 15. If they want stricter immutability we flag as Dedicated/Private add-on and loop legal.

leah_sec: Copy for email: "Logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customer-managed KMS supported for archival; Object Lock for immutability. Audit access is role-restricted and logged."

ryan_se: Sent to Meridian procurement at 2025-12-05T11:55:23Z. Marking resolved unless they request network allowlist or SLA changes.
